units.source_text: “大家本来都想来送行的，可昨晚睡得太迟，今早起不来，让我赔礼道歉来了。

en.t: Everyone had meant to come and see you off, but they went to bed too late last night and could not get up this morning, so they sent me to apologize.

units.source_text: 她们说，等着您冬天再来。

en.t: They said they will be waiting for you to come again in winter.
